args.question: Could you clarify two things about this claim: (1) Is this kitchen grease fire/smoke damage a new, separate incident, or is it related to the electrical issue you previously reported to us? If related, please give us that prior claim number so we can link or merge them. (2) Since you mentioned a contractor quote is still pending, could you let us know the estimated claim amount (or send the quote/receipts) once you have it, along with the date you first reported this incident?
